title: 第1548章 女妖的实验第1547章 又得阵法下
content_zh:
长卿直接叫来了海棠，让她唤来了几个得力部下。
他这次掌握了阵法，准备尝试着将几个女妖送出去，看看能否成功。
“这几个姐妹都是顷刻六七转之间的境界，正好符合主人您的要求。”
长卿没直接用海棠做实验，她本身是自己的得力助手，有她管理百花宗自己还很放心，若是这次实验出了什么岔子，把她直接搞死了，自己难免头疼。
用几个不太重要的女妖实验就不会有这种问题了，而且境界越低损失越小不说，长卿催动起阵法应该也会更容易。
长卿先从这几个女妖中挑选了三个人，让她们站在了彩云间大殿中的那面大镜附近。
理论上嬴冲火布置的阵法覆盖整个百花传承，只要长卿想的话，可以在任何地方催动阵法将这些女妖送出去。
但这面大镜子是阵法的中心，理论上也是阵法力量最强之处，在这里催动的话，成功的概率应该会大大提高。
“准备好了么，如果成功之后，你们应该会身处一个陌生的环境，不要发出任何声音也不要有多余的动作，待在原地等我的安排，明白了么。”
“是，主人。”
那三名女妖激动的浑身颤抖，一方面是听说居然能见识到外面的世界，一方面是能被百花宗之主选作第一批实验者，对她们而言乃是无上的荣耀。
三名女妖跪在地上，等待着长卿出手，长卿闭上双眼，尝试着用寰宇股掌控制灵阵。
嬴冲火对他并没有藏私，他修炼了寰宇股掌之后，控制百花洞的灵阵无比丝滑，就仿佛这灵阵原本就是他自己布置的一样。
只是心念一动，眼前的三名女妖就从原地消失。
长卿赶忙去看阵法中央的大镜，只见三女妖身处自己的房间内，正紧张地站在原地，正正好好出现在百花传承的本体旁。
“成功了！”
长卿不禁心中一喜，但又连忙将这种喜悦压制下去。
实验还没结束，有来有回，才算成功。
念及于此，长卿连忙离开百花传承，出现在三名女妖面前。
三名女妖见了长卿，齐齐跪在地上，谨遵长卿的吩咐，并不敢随意发出声音，长卿眼疾手快，立刻催动隔音灵将整个房间全都覆盖。

利用黄泉蚁蚊探查了一下周围一切安全后，他这才开口道。
“可以说话了，都起来，我们还没实验完。”
“是，主人。”
三名女妖恭敬起身。
“就在这屋内，稍微活动一下，试试看有没有什么不适的感觉。”
三名女妖尝试着走了几圈，纷纷表示一切正常。
“试试看能不能吸收周围的灵气。”
三女妖再次尝试，外界的灵气她们照样能正常吸收。
“再试试释放本相，催动御灵。”
content_en:
Chang Qing called Haitang directly and asked her to summon several capable subordinates.
He mastered the formation this time and was going to try to send a few banshees out to see if he could succeed.
"These sisters are all in the realm of six or seven transformations in an instant, which exactly meets your requirements, Master."
Changqing did not directly use Haitang for experiments. She was his right-hand assistant, and he felt relieved to have her manage Baihua Sect. If something went wrong in this experiment and she was killed directly, he would inevitably have a headache.
Experimenting with a few less important banshees won't have this problem, and the lower the realm, the smaller the losses, and it should be easier for Chang Qing to activate the formation.
Changqing first selected three people from these banshees and asked them to stand near the large mirror in the Caiyunjian Hall.
Theoretically, the formation arranged by Ying Chonghuo covers the entire Hundred Flowers Heritage. If Chang Qing wants to, he can activate the formation anywhere to send these banshees out.
But this large mirror is the center of the formation. In theory, it is also the strongest point of the formation. If activated here, the probability of success should be greatly improved.
"Are you ready? If successful, you should be in an unfamiliar environment. Don't make any noise or make any unnecessary movements. Just stay where you are and wait for my arrangements. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."
The three banshees were trembling with excitement. On the one hand, they heard that they could actually see the outside world, and on the other hand, it was a supreme honor for them to be selected by the Lord of the Hundred Flowers Sect as the first batch of experimenters.
The three banshees knelt on the ground, waiting for Changqing to take action. Changqing closed his eyes and tried to control the spiritual formation with the Universal Palm.
Ying Chonghuo had no secrets against him. After he practiced the Universal Palm, he controlled the spiritual formation in Baihua Cave extremely smoothly, as if he had originally arranged the spiritual formation himself.
Just with a thought, the three banshees in front of me disappeared from where they were.
Changqing hurriedly looked at the large mirror in the center of the formation, and saw the three banshees in his room, standing nervously on the spot, appearing right next to the main body of the Hundred Flowers Inheritance.
"Success!"
Changqing couldn't help but feel happy, but he quickly suppressed this joy.
The experiment is not over yet, it will only be considered successful if it comes and goes.
Thinking of this, Changqing quickly left the Hundred Flowers Heritage and appeared in front of the three banshees.
When the three banshees saw Chang Qing, they all knelt on the ground, obeying Chang Qing's instructions and not daring to make any noise at will. Chang Qing, with quick eyes and quick hands, immediately activated the soundproof spirit to cover the entire room.
After using Huangquan Ant Mosquito to check the safety of everything around him, he spoke.
"You can talk now. Get up. We haven't finished the experiment yet."
"Yes, Master."
The three banshees stood up respectfully.
"Just move around a little bit in this room and see if you feel any discomfort."
The three banshees tried to walk around a few times and all said everything was normal.
"Try to see if you can absorb the spiritual energy around you."
The three banshees tried again, and they could still absorb the aura from the outside world normally.
"Try to release your true form again and activate the Yuling."
